title: HIBP Breach Exposure Receipt
description: Receipt for Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) breach-exposure intelligence checks. Governs which actions are safe, which require human approval, and which are forbidden.

query_subject.description: Subject of the query (email, domain, password hash prefix, breach name). Sensitive — must be redacted if a personal email.

query_subject_redacted.description: Whether the query_subject has been redacted before persistence

api_key_used.description: Whether an HIBP API key was used (key itself must never be in the receipt)

operator_approval.description: Operator approval status for this query

operator_approval_by.description: Identity of the operator who approved/denied

mode.description: Receipt mode — advisory only, approved lookup, or forbidden (query was rejected)

actions_taken.description: Actions taken based on findings (e.g. 'notified operator', 'recommended password rotation')

forbidden_actions_avoided.description: Actions that were considered but correctly avoided (e.g. 'did not store raw passwords', 'did not expose breach details publicly')

redacted.description: Whether sensitive data has been redacted before persistence

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt content (excluding the hash field itself)
